name: Starbucks
fiscalYearEnd: Sunday closest to September 30 (FY2025 ended 2025-09-28; FY2026 ends 2026-09-27)
description: Starbucks sells coffee, other drinks and food through 40,990 stores (21,514 company-operated, 19,476 licensed; 16,864 in the US and 8,011 in China at FY2025 end). In company-operated stores it books the full sales and bears the labor and rent; in licensed stores (airports, grocery, partners) it sells products and takes royalties. A third segment sells packaged coffee and ready-to-drink products in grocery through a Nestle alliance, at very high margin. FY2025 was a bad year: operating income fell 46% to $2.94B and a 'Back to Starbucks' turnaround closed 627 stores in Q4 with $892M of restructuring and impairment charges. By Q3 FY2026 comparable sales were up 7.9% globally, the fourth straight quarter of growth.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source in this pass.

businessLines.name: North America
businessLines.how: Sells coffee, food and merchandise in company-operated stores (Starbucks books the full store sales and costs) and through licensed stores (US and Canada) for product sales and royalties.

businessLines.name: International
businessLines.how: Company-operated and licensed stores across China, Japan, Europe and elsewhere; licensed stores pay product sales and royalties. Certain markets are still in development and need more support than their profit implies (10-K).

businessLines.name: Channel Development
businessLines.how: Sells packaged coffee, ready-to-drink drinks and foodservice products outside stores; a large portion is licensed to Nestle through the Global Coffee Alliance, so Starbucks earns royalties and product sales at very high margin.

brands.name: Global Coffee Alliance (Nestle)
brands.note: Packaged coffee, single-serve and ready-to-drink; Channel Development revenue $1.87B FY2025, operating income $885M

whatsNext.text: Starbucks China transaction referenced in Q3 FY2026 release as reducing revenue; terms and closing date not extracted
